title: Aurra Sing
subtitle: Independent
description: Known for her chalk white skin, elongated fingers and unusual antennae, Aurra Sing was a ruthless bounty hunter. An expert sniper and trained assassin, she would work for the highest bidder on virtually any job. She took a young Boba Fett under her wing, though she ended up betraying him. She eventually met her end at the hands of Tobias Beckett -or at least the fall ended her when he pushed her.
